methodBoundary: Five anti-cases were frozen before theory coding. This audit occurs only after Pass A, source lock, primary Pass B, independent coding and replay freeze; it does not mutate S1-S10/F1-F7.

cases.finding: Chain Home is a direct anti-case to sophistication prestige: a coarse, long-wavelength, fixed system can be frontier-optimal when deployment time and decision-network integration dominate precision. Later magnetron capability changes the action space rather than retroactively making the earlier choice irrational.

Matrix and wave mechanics can converge predictively while remaining different representations and while interpretive ontology remains unsettled. Predictive equivalence does not require one intuitive representation to win; this narrows any reading of S1/S10 that expects a unique privileged representation.

Insulin became reproducibly life-saving before molecular structure and modern pharmacology were known. Useful intervention can precede full causal ontology, while repeatable consequence still requires purification, potency standards, manufacturing and dose control.

High-impact wartime computation remained narrow, manually configured and embedded in a human analytic/operational workflow. Generality and autonomy are not prerequisites for frontier value or metaproductivity. Independent coding again marks S1 NOT_APPLICABLE here, reinforcing that Representation recurrence must not be mapped onto every trajectory.

Richardson shows that a substantially correct mathematical formulation can be operationally unusable because compute speed, initialization/data, numerical balance and error structure are missing. Correctness, present tractability and present decision value are distinct.

measurementFinding: HD4 exact coder agreement falls to 69/120 (57.5%) and coarse applicability to 90/120 (75.0%). The high-complexity epoch therefore does not support a monotonic taxonomy-convergence story. S5 and S9 remain especially coder-sensitive, while S3/S7/S10 have 12/12 coarse applicability agreement.
worldModelUpdate: Anti-cases continue to narrow quantifiers and value orderings more often than they falsify the frozen structures. Four epochs without an adjudicated direct contradiction remains an active falsifiability concern; later waves should preserve stronger explicit negation conditions rather than treating recurrence as proof.
